properties.description: The migration path for a project still on one .json file (every project but reflow2 today, and every design flo2.io holds): the single file imports through the same reader as the layout; exported to the directory beside it (demo.json -> demo/) it becomes the layout with the single file's content hash, design.json records that hash as migrated_from, the layout imports cleanly, and read back out as a single file it is the original design.
properties.findings: 2026-10-04 (chg:item-layout-lineage-holds-through-a-conflict-resolved-mid-merge-2026-10-04): a_single_file_design_still_imports_and_converts_to_the_layout_beside_it passes. It does not cover reflow2_init converting a project (cap:a-project-migrates-to-the-item-layout stays planned).
properties.name: A single-file design still imports, and converts to the item layout beside it with nothing lost
